about_the_game:
Keep the musical combat flowing with “Resurrections”, by the award-winning composer of Celeste, Lena Raine. (This track is part of the Celeste Music Pack.) 

This Rhythm Rift comes with:

  • A fully-bopping Badeline character

  • Celeste Background Visualizer with Strawberry Particle FX

  • Four Difficulties:

    • Easy, Medium, Hard and Impossible

  • Remix Mode:

    • Experience a fresh beatmap your way every playthrough while enjoying the original level's rhythmic design.

To celebrate the release of the Celeste Music Pack, we’ve also added a free Rhythm Rift to the base game for everyone:

  • Resurrections (Remix) by Danny Baranowsky

Thanks for grooving!
